item.title: Birding Log (1.4)
item.description:
Version: 1.4
Author: Vinny
Category: LotRO StandAlone Plugins
Updated: 2026-10-06 00:34 UTC
Downloads: 39,520
File: BirdingLog_1.4.zip (57.4 KB)

This plugin keeps a record of all birds seen by each character and optionally the birds seen at a particular location by any character. It also provides convenient shortcuts to equip your birding kit birdwatch and then switch back to your weapon.

Basic chat commands:
/bl Display birding proficiency.
/bl sight List birding sighting records.
/bl zones List birding zones and counts.
/bl <name> Set count for <name> to .
/blg Show birding garment for selected zone.
/bll ;loc Set the current birding zone.
/bll list List sightings in the selected zone.
item.author: noreply@lotrointerface.com (Vinny)

item.title: Fishing Log (1.4)
item.description:
Version: 1.4
Author: Vinny
Category: LotRO StandAlone Plugins
Updated: 2026-10-06 00:26 UTC
Downloads: 33,849
File: FishingLog_1.4.zip (45.3 KB)

This plugin keeps a record of all fish caught by each character and optionally the fish caught at a particular location by any character. It also provides convenient shortcuts to equip your fishing rod and fish and then switch back to your weapon.

Basic chat commands:
/fl Display fishing proficiency.
/fl <link> Display item details.
/fl catch List fishing catch records.
/fl cook List fish that can be cooked.
/fl quest List fish that are part of a quest.
/fl trophy List fish that are trophies.
/fl track Toggle unknown fish tracking.
item.author: noreply@lotrointerface.com (Vinny)

Category: LotRO StandAlone Plugins
Updated: 2026-08-30 12:02 UTC
Downloads: 296
File: ZoltanTime1.01.zip (116.1 KB)

ZoltanTime can display your local time and server time
and ingame day/night cycle.

Youll need to adjust the ingame cycle offset in options until it
best matches the actual ingame day/night phase.

The ingame time display is especially useful for those quests/kill deeds etc. that can only be done at a certain time of day/night.


Leftclicking the minimalised icon will toggle the main Time Window on/off

This is a VERY minimalistic even niche plugin that tracks the Herbalist Dailies.
When the plugin loads look for a Foragers Basket icon. This is how you show the main window of the tracker. Right clicking it toggles it off and on. You can click and drag the icon with the left mouse button.

The main window and options can be drug around by clicking and holding the left mouse button on the header then dragging to where you want it.

item.description:

Author: Thardariel
Category: LotRO StandAlone Plugins
Updated: 2023-01-17 14:20 UTC
Downloads: 52,242
File: WelcomeToMiddleEarth Version 1.3.zip (831.0 KB)

WelcomeToMiddleEarth enhances the leveling game experience.

The following functions are unlocked after loading the plugin

When leveling up a window with the next learnable skills appears
Milestones from The Lord of the Rings movies are displayed when reaching certain levels with movie quotes and images

Designed for all three client languages.

The plugin can be used for all classes from level 1 after loading the plugin there are no further necessary steps. The plugin is triggered by ascending the character level.
